proposal.title: Pelnaetesh: a checker for confusable domain names
proposal.summary: Pelnaetesh builds a checker for confusable domain names for registries and browser makers.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: Lookalike names in other scripts are used to deceive users. Registries and browser makers depend on internationalised domain names every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We will build a checker for confusable domain names called Pelnaetesh. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

sections.heading: Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
sections.text: Internationalised domain names is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We maintain http://forge.test/pelnaetesh/pelnaetesh, which 122 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on internationalised domain names for 10 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under the MIT licence in http://forge.test/pelnaetesh/pelnaetesh. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 12 months in 4 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 6. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 9. Documentation and release ends in month 12.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 56050.00 EUR for 97 days of work over 4 tasks. Day rates range from 450.00 EUR to 750.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Problem
Lookalike names in other scripts are used to deceive users. Registries and browser makers depend on internationalised domain names every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

Approach
We will build a checker for confusable domain names called Pelnaetesh. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
Internationalised domain names is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

Team and experience
We maintain http://forge.test/pelnaetesh/pelnaetesh, which 122 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on internationalised domain names for 10 years.

Deliverables and licence
All code will be released under the MIT licence in http://forge.test/pelnaetesh/pelnaetesh. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

Milestones
The work runs over 12 months in 4 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 6. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 9. Documentation and release ends in month 12.

Budget justification
The plan asks for 56050.00 EUR for 97 days of work over 4 tasks. Day rates range from 450.00 EUR to 750.00 EUR.
